CREATE TABLE runtime_receipts (
              receipt_id text primary key,
              harness text not null,
              artifact_id text not null,
              artifact_hash text not null,
              policy_decision text not null,
              capabilities_summary text not null default '',
              changed_capabilities_json text not null,
              provenance_summary text not null,
              user_override text,
              artifact_name text,
              source_scope text,
              scanner_evidence_json text not null default '[]',
              timestamp text not null,
              raw_command_text text
            , diff_summary text, approval_source text, approval_request_id text)

CREATE TABLE runtime_receipt_envelopes (
              receipt_id text primary key references runtime_receipts(receipt_id) on delete cascade,
              envelope_full_json text,
              envelope_redacted_json text not null
            )

CREATE TABLE guard_events (
              event_id integer primary key autoincrement,
              event_name text not null,
              payload_json text not null,
              occurred_at text not null
            )

CREATE TABLE guard_cloud_events (
              event_id text primary key,
              idempotency_key text not null unique,
              event_type text not null,
              payload_json text not null,
              occurred_at text not null,
              uploaded_at text
            )

CREATE TABLE approval_requests (
          request_id text primary key,
          harness text not null,
          artifact_id text not null,
          artifact_name text not null,
          artifact_type text not null,
          artifact_hash text not null,
          publisher text,
          policy_action text not null,
          recommended_scope text not null,
          changed_fields_json text not null,
          source_scope text not null,
          oauth_source text,
          config_path text not null,
          workspace text,
          launch_target text,
          normalized_identity_key text,
          action_identity text,
          queue_group_id text,
          dedupe_count integer not null default 1,
          last_seen_at text,
          transport text,
          risk_summary text,
          risk_signals_json text not null default '[]',
          artifact_label text,
          source_label text,
          trigger_summary text,
          why_now text,
          launch_summary text,
          risk_headline text,
          action_envelope_json text,
          decision_v2_json text,
          fallback_cli_command text,
          scanner_evidence_json text not null default '[]',
          browser_intent_json text,
          desktop_notified_at text,
          raw_command_text text,
          continuation_snapshot_json text,
          extension_allow_hint_json text,
          guard_version text,
          first_seen_guard_version text,
          last_seen_guard_version text,
          watch_only_observation integer not null default 0,
          review_command text not null,
          approval_url text not null,
          status text not null,
          resolution_action text,
          resolution_scope text,
          reason text,
          created_at text not null,
          resolved_at text
        )

CREATE TABLE native_hook_decision_receipts (
      decision_id text primary key,
      schema text not null check (schema = 'guard-native-hook-decision-receipt.v1'),
      version integer not null check (version = 1),
      authority text not null check (authority = 'rust'),
      request_id text not null,
      request_digest text not null,
      harness text not null,
      event_name text not null check (event_name in ('PreToolUse', 'PostToolUse')),
      payload_kind text not null,
      policy_generation integer not null,
      policy_digest text,
      rule_digest text,
      runtime_identity text,
      decision text not null check (decision in ('allow', 'deny')),
      model_output_action text not null,
      policy_action text,
      observed_policy_action text,
      reason_code text not null,
      workspace_bound integer not null check (workspace_bound in (0, 1)),
      source_ref_external_allowed integer not null check (source_ref_external_allowed in (0, 1)),
      reviewed_output_sha256 text,
      observe_mode integer not null check (observe_mode in (0, 1)),
      deadline_budget_ms integer,
      command_extensions_json text check (command_extensions_json is null or length(command_extensions_json) between 2 and 2048),
      
      recorded_at text not null
    )

CREATE TABLE native_prompt_decision_receipts (
      decision_id text primary key,
      schema text not null check (schema = 'guard-native-hook-decision-receipt.v1'),
      version integer not null check (version = 1),
      authority text not null check (authority = 'rust'),
      request_id text not null,
      request_digest text not null,
      harness text not null,
      event_name text not null check (event_name = 'UserPromptSubmit'),
      payload_kind text not null,
      policy_generation integer not null,
      policy_digest text,
      rule_digest text,
      runtime_identity text,
      decision text not null check (decision in ('allow', 'deny')),
      model_output_action text not null,
      policy_action text,
      observed_policy_action text,
      reason_code text not null,
      workspace_bound integer not null check (workspace_bound in (0, 1)),
      source_ref_external_allowed integer not null check (source_ref_external_allowed in (0, 1)),
      reviewed_output_sha256 text,
      observe_mode integer not null check (observe_mode in (0, 1)),
      deadline_budget_ms integer,
      command_extensions_json text check (command_extensions_json is null or length(command_extensions_json) between 2 and 2048),
      prompt_risk_classes_json text not null check (length(prompt_risk_classes_json) between 2 and 256),
      recorded_at text not null
    )

CREATE TABLE guard_workflow_capabilities (
      capability_id text primary key,
      approval_provenance_id text not null,
      nonce text not null unique,
      signed_claim_json text not null,
      key_id text not null,
      issued_at text not null,
      not_before text not null,
      expires_at text not null,
      max_uses integer not null check (max_uses between 1 and 50),
      used_count integer not null default 0 check (used_count between 0 and max_uses),
      revoked_at text,
      revocation_code text,
      check ((revoked_at is null and revocation_code is null) or
             (revoked_at is not null and revocation_code is not null))
    ) strict

CREATE TABLE guard_workflow_capability_receipts (
      receipt_id text primary key,
      capability_id text not null references guard_workflow_capabilities(capability_id),
      task_id text not null,
      invocation_id text not null unique,
      approval_provenance_id text not null,
      signed_receipt_json text not null,
      claimed_at text not null,
      use_number integer not null check (use_number >= 1),
      event_id integer not null references guard_events(event_id),
      unique (capability_id, use_number)
    ) strict

CREATE TABLE guard_workflow_capability_authority_transitions (
      sequence integer primary key,
      capability_id text not null references guard_workflow_capabilities(capability_id),
      revision integer not null check (revision >= 0),
      transition_kind text not null,
      previous_transition_sha256 text not null,
      signed_transition_json text not null,
      key_id text not null,
      event_id integer not null unique references guard_events(event_id),
      unique (capability_id, revision)
    ) strict

CREATE TABLE receipt_rollup_actions (
          receipt_id text primary key references runtime_receipts(receipt_id) on delete cascade,
          policy_decision text not null,
          dirty integer not null default 0 check (dirty in (0, 1))
        )

CREATE TABLE guard_storage_maintenance (
          singleton integer primary key check (singleton = 1),
          archived_receipts integer not null default 0,
          last_run_at text,
          last_receipts_archived integer not null default 0,
          last_guard_events_deleted integer not null default 0,
          last_cloud_events_deleted integer not null default 0,
          last_pages_reclaimed integer not null default 0
        )

CREATE INDEX idx_guard_events_recent
            on guard_events (occurred_at desc, event_id desc)

CREATE INDEX idx_guard_events_name_recent
            on guard_events (event_name, occurred_at desc, event_id desc)

CREATE INDEX idx_guard_cloud_events_sync
            on guard_cloud_events (uploaded_at, occurred_at)

CREATE INDEX idx_native_hook_decision_receipts_recorded_at
        on native_hook_decision_receipts (recorded_at)

CREATE INDEX idx_native_prompt_decision_receipts_recorded_at
        on native_prompt_decision_receipts (recorded_at)

CREATE INDEX idx_guard_workflow_capability_expiry
    on guard_workflow_capabilities (revoked_at, expires_at, capability_id)

CREATE INDEX idx_guard_workflow_receipt_capability
    on guard_workflow_capability_receipts (capability_id, use_number)

CREATE INDEX idx_guard_workflow_receipt_event
    on guard_workflow_capability_receipts (event_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_approval_status_created on approval_requests(status, created_at desc)
CREATE INDEX idx_approval_status_harness_created on approval_requests(status, harness, created_at desc)
CREATE INDEX idx_approval_status_identity_workspace on approval_requests(status, normalized_identity_key, workspace)
CREATE INDEX idx_approval_source_group_status on approval_requests(oauth_source, queue_group_id, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_approval_status_last_seen on approval_requests(status, last_seen_at desc, request_id desc)
CREATE INDEX idx_approval_status_harness_last_seen on approval_requests(status, harness, last_seen_at desc, request_id desc)
CREATE INDEX idx_approval_harness_status on approval_requests(harness, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_approval_artifact_hash on approval_requests(artifact_hash)
CREATE INDEX idx_approval_workspace_status on approval_requests(workspace, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_approval_policy_action on approval_requests(policy_action)
CREATE INDEX idx_approval_status_watch_last_seen on approval_requests(status, watch_only_observation, last_seen_at desc, request_id desc)
CREATE INDEX idx_approval_resolution on approval_requests(resolution_action, resolved_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_harness_artifact on runtime_receipts(harness, artifact_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_timestamp_harness on runtime_receipts(timestamp, harness)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_timestamp_desc on runtime_receipts(timestamp desc)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_harness_timestamp_desc on runtime_receipts(harness, timestamp desc)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_harness_artifact_timestamp_desc on runtime_receipts(harness, artifact_id, timestamp desc)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipts_approval_request_decision on runtime_receipts(approval_request_id, policy_decision)
CREATE INDEX idx_receipt_rollup_actions_dirty on receipt_rollup_actions(dirty) where dirty = 1

CREATE TRIGGER trg_guard_workflow_capability_claim_immutable
    before update of capability_id, approval_provenance_id, nonce, signed_claim_json, key_id,
      issued_at, not_before, expires_at, max_uses on guard_workflow_capabilities
    begin select raise(abort, 'workflow_capability_claim_immutable'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_guard_workflow_capability_no_delete
    before delete on guard_workflow_capabilities
    begin select raise(abort, 'workflow_capability_delete_forbidden'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_guard_workflow_receipt_immutable_update
    before update on guard_workflow_capability_receipts
    begin select raise(abort, 'workflow_capability_receipt_immutable'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_guard_workflow_receipt_immutable_delete
    before delete on guard_workflow_capability_receipts
    begin select raise(abort, 'workflow_capability_receipt_delete_forbidden'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_guard_workflow_event_preserve_link
    before delete on guard_events when exists (
      select 1 from guard_workflow_capability_receipts where event_id = old.event_id
      union all
      select 1 from guard_workflow_capability_authority_transitions where event_id = old.event_id
    ) begin select raise(abort, 'workflow_capability_event_referenced'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_guard_workflow_transition_immutable_update
    before update on guard_workflow_capability_authority_transitions
    begin select raise(abort, 'workflow_capability_transition_immutable'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_guard_workflow_transition_immutable_delete
    before delete on guard_workflow_capability_authority_transitions
    begin select raise(abort, 'workflow_capability_transition_delete_forbidden'); end

CREATE TRIGGER receipt_rollup_runtime_insert_dirty
        after insert on runtime_receipts
        begin
          insert into receipt_rollup_actions (receipt_id, policy_decision, dirty)
          values (new.receipt_id, new.policy_decision, 1)
          on conflict(receipt_id) do update set dirty = 1;
        end

CREATE TRIGGER receipt_rollup_runtime_authority_dirty
        after update of policy_decision, approval_request_id on runtime_receipts
        begin
          insert into receipt_rollup_actions (receipt_id, policy_decision, dirty)
          values (new.receipt_id, old.policy_decision, 1)
          on conflict(receipt_id) do update set dirty = 1;
        end

CREATE TRIGGER receipt_rollup_envelope_insert_dirty
        after insert on runtime_receipt_envelopes
        begin
          insert into receipt_rollup_actions (receipt_id, policy_decision, dirty)
          select r.receipt_id, r.policy_decision, 1
          from runtime_receipts r
          where r.receipt_id = new.receipt_id
          on conflict(receipt_id) do update set dirty = 1;
        end

CREATE TRIGGER receipt_rollup_envelope_update_dirty
        after update of envelope_full_json, envelope_redacted_json on runtime_receipt_envelopes
        begin
          insert into receipt_rollup_actions (receipt_id, policy_decision, dirty)
          select r.receipt_id, r.policy_decision, 1
          from runtime_receipts r
          where r.receipt_id = new.receipt_id
          on conflict(receipt_id) do update set dirty = 1;
        end

CREATE TRIGGER receipt_rollup_envelope_delete_dirty
        after delete on runtime_receipt_envelopes
        begin
          insert into receipt_rollup_actions (receipt_id, policy_decision, dirty)
          select r.receipt_id, r.policy_decision, 1
          from runtime_receipts r
          where r.receipt_id = old.receipt_id
          on conflict(receipt_id) do update set dirty = 1;
        end
